description: 45 production rules across geometry, typography, colour/contrast, accessibility, structure, content, links, media, compatibility, performance, and security. Severity can be overridden per rule; rules can be disabled by id.

rules.title: Shape outside the slide canvas
rules.description: Any shape whose bounding box extends beyond the slide edge.
rules.fix: Move or resize the shape inside the canvas.

rules.title: Text inside the safe-margin band
rules.description: Text that sits closer than edge_margin_in to any slide edge.
rules.fix: Reposition the text to the theme margin grid.

rules.title: Overlapping text frames
rules.description: Two text-bearing shapes overlap by 20 percent or more of the smaller one.
rules.fix: Separate the frames or merge them into one.

rules.title: Zero-size shape
rules.description: A shape with zero or negative width or height, which can break rendering.
rules.fix: Delete the shape or restore its geometry.

rules.title: Text hidden behind an opaque shape
rules.description: A text-bearing shape is almost fully covered by an opaque shape that sits above it in the z-order, so the text is invisible in the rendered slide.
rules.fix: Move the covering shape behind the text, shrink it, or remove its fill.

rules.title: Font size below minimum
rules.description: Explicit body text smaller than audit.min_font_pt.
rules.fix: Raise the size to the minimum and re-check overflow.

rules.title: Font outside the approved list
rules.description: A run uses a font family not in audit.font_allowlist.
rules.fix: Substitute an approved font.

rules.title: Mixed font families in one text box
rules.description: More than two font families inside a single text frame.
rules.fix: Unify to one or two families.

rules.title: Estimated text overflow
rules.description: Rendered text height exceeds the shape height by more than overflow_tolerance (font-metric estimate).
rules.fix: Shorten the copy or enlarge the frame.

rules.title: Empty placeholder
rules.description: A placeholder with no text is left on the slide.
rules.fix: Remove the empty placeholder.

rules.title: Title below minimum size
rules.description: A title run smaller than audit.min_title_pt.
rules.fix: Set the title to the theme title size.

rules.title: Contrast below WCAG
rules.description: Text/background contrast below 4.5:1 (3:1 for large text).
rules.fix: Choose a text colour with sufficient contrast.

rules.title: Text invisible on background
rules.description: Text colour is identical to the effective background.
rules.fix: Recolour the text for visibility.

rules.title: Slide has no title
rules.description: No title placeholder or detectable title text.
rules.fix: Add a title that states the slide message.

rules.title: Missing alt text
rules.description: A picture, chart, or media shape has no alt text.
rules.fix: Add descriptive alt text; mark decorative art as decorative.

rules.title: Title not first in reading order
rules.description: The title placeholder is not the first text shape in the shape tree.
rules.fix: Move the title to the front of the reading order.

rules.title: Duplicate slide titles
rules.description: Two or more slides share the same title, which confuses navigation and screen readers.
rules.fix: Give each slide a distinct, descriptive title.

rules.title: Table missing header row
rules.description: A table does not mark its first row as a header.
rules.fix: Enable 'Header Row' on the table.

rules.title: Chart without a title
rules.description: A chart has no chart title, so its message is unclear out of context.
rules.fix: Add a chart title or keep the slide title descriptive.

rules.title: Speaker notes missing
rules.description: More than half of the slides have no speaker notes.
rules.fix: Add notes so the deck can be delivered consistently.

rules.title: Raw URL as link text
rules.description: Hyperlink text is a bare URL instead of descriptive text.
rules.fix: Use descriptive link text.

rules.title: Empty slide
rules.description: A slide with no text, picture, chart, or table.
rules.fix: Delete the slide or add content.

rules.title: Deck exceeds the slide budget
rules.description: Slide count above max_slide_budget.
rules.fix: Split the deck or trim content.

rules.title: Placeholder text found
rules.description: Placeholder strings such as 'lorem ipsum', 'TODO', or 'TBD' remain.
rules.fix: Replace the placeholder with final copy.

rules.title: Title too long
rules.description: Title longer than max_title_chars characters.
rules.fix: Shorten the title to a single clear line.

rules.title: Too many bullets in one box
rules.description: More than max_bullets_per_shape paragraphs in one text box.
rules.fix: Split the content across slides.

rules.title: Overlong bullet
rules.description: A bullet longer than max_bullet_chars characters.
rules.fix: Tighten the sentence or move detail to notes.

rules.title: Blocked hyperlink protocol
rules.description: A hyperlink uses a blocked protocol (javascript:, data:, vbscript:, file:).
rules.fix: Remove or replace the unsafe link.

rules.title: External web links present
rules.description: The deck contains http(s) links that will not work offline.
rules.fix: Confirm the links are reachable for the delivery context.

rules.title: Broken internal slide jump
rules.description: A slide-jump action does not resolve to an existing slide.
rules.fix: Repoint the action to a live slide.

rules.title: Empty media part
rules.description: A media part has zero bytes and will not play or display.
rules.fix: Replace or remove the media.

rules.title: Large media part
rules.description: A media part larger than large_media_mb.
rules.fix: Compress or link the media externally.

rules.title: Image resolution above target
rules.description: A picture's pixel edge exceeds max_image_pixels for its placement.
rules.fix: Run optimize to downscale the image.

rules.title: Embedded OLE object
rules.description: An embedded OLE object may not render in web or mobile viewers.
rules.fix: Convert the object to an image or native shape.

rules.title: 3D model part present
rules.description: 3D models need recent PowerPoint builds and do not render on the web.
rules.fix: Provide a 2D fallback image.

rules.title: Vector media may vary
rules.description: EMF/WMF/SVG parts render differently across platforms.
rules.fix: Provide a PNG fallback for critical graphics.

rules.title: Unapproved fonts used
rules.description: Deck fonts outside audit.font_allowlist may substitute on other machines.
rules.fix: Switch to approved fonts or embed them at export.

rules.title: Morph transition used
rules.description: Morph transitions require PowerPoint 2019 or Microsoft 365.
rules.fix: Confirm the target audience can play Morph.

rules.title: File size above budget
rules.description: File larger than max_file_mb.
rules.fix: Run optimize and remove unused media.

rules.title: Duplicate media
rules.description: Byte-identical media is stored more than once.
rules.fix: Deduplicate the media parts.

rules.title: Unreferenced media
rules.description: Media parts that no slide relationship references.
rules.fix: Drop the unused parts with optimize --drop-unused-media.

rules.title: VBA macro project present
rules.description: The package contains a macro project; macros are disabled by default and may be blocked by policy.
rules.fix: Remove the macro or distribute as .pptm with a clear trust note.

rules.title: External relationship targets
rules.description: The package links to external resources.
rules.fix: Confirm every external target is trusted and reachable.

rules.title: Embedded file/object
rules.description: Embedded files must be reviewed before distribution.
rules.fix: Remove or sanitise the embedded content.

rules.title: Executable or macro-enabled content
rules.description: The package embeds executables or macro-enabled documents.
rules.fix: Remove the content and rebuild the deck.
